description: Access to the embedded headless document layout bundle — the canvas editor's layout chain (layout snapshot export → display list → pagination → line breaker/paragraph engine/font metrics) compiled into a single ESM artifact by scripts/build-document-editor.mjs (npm run build:document-editor). Server-side layout hosts evaluate this script to produce the exact layout snapshot the browser editor exports, giving WYSIWYG parity by construction without a C# port of the layout code. Text measurement is injectable: pass a { measureRun } partial as options.fontMetrics, or create a service via createFontMetricsService — without a canvas context it falls back to deterministic synthetic metrics.
